 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be 
 performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title block.
This pump is used to unloading the alum from the car tank to the storage tank.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawe, tested at 
 September 2008, revised by MDEP Co. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Mageed Sowan.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Nageeb 
 inspection & quality control's head sector.
Alum unloading pump | P-021 A/B
MANUFACTUR | Savino barbera
MODEL | OMA 40A
TYPE | Closed coupled horizontal CP suction single stage pump
NUMBER OF STAGES | 1
SPEED | 2800
EL MOTOR POWER | 1.5 KW
LIQUID HANDIED | Aluminum sulfate 40 %
CAPACITY | 9M/H
HEAD | 10 MWC
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask ...etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drainage.
Tools 
and Equipment
Supports and thicknesses
Parallel v block
Hexagonal socket or elbowed wrenchs 
 (16,23,30mm)
Wrenches (8,13,17and 19 mm)
Puller 
 for pins 3,4,6,8mm
Bearing extractor
Pair of levers
Monkey wrench
Hammer
Rubber hummer
Twist 
 drill 3,4,6,8 mm
Vernier slide gauge
Emery cloth
Surface gauge.
Work to be 
carried out
Check pump capacity, pressure and power .
Check the Noisy of the Pump.
Check the pump and piping for leaks
Check the fixation
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting; it 
 is clockwise
The level of liquid in the tank must be above the minimum 
 level
The on off valve in the suction from the tank ,must be 
 completely open, while the air discharge valve after complete priming if 
 applicable-and the draining valve must be closed.
The control valve in delivery to the pump , must be 
 partially-but never completely closed
The check must be carried out be qualified and competent 
 operators , starting the motor for a few second
Attendance 
and checking during operation of the pump, the following should be checked:
Check of flow rate , delivery head and absorbed power
Check the water leakage of 
 pump
Check the pump pressure
Check the bolts of foundation
Check alignment and record at M.R.D.S.
Check coupling .
Check vibration
